svg.text: BioScout pressure sensor — Arduino Uno wiring
5V → FSR leg 1 · FSR leg 2 → A0 and 10 kΩ · 10 kΩ → GND (blue rail)
Each breadboard column of 5 holes is one connection; the two halves (above/below the gap) are separate. Lamps stay on 13/12/11/8/7.
Vout(A0) = 5 V × 10k / (10k + R_fsr) → reading 0 (no touch) … ~1000 (hard press)
